sentence: This project tests whether somatic mitochondrial mutations link aging, neurodegeneration and mitochondrial dysfunction to Alzheimer’s disease.
This project provides genetic, genomic and bioinformatic services that help vision researchers study RNA and DNA from animals or humans.
This project sets up core services that help researchers study how brain circuits go wrong in addiction and relapse.
This project studies how socioeconomic disparities, genetic variants and accelerated brain age affect Alzheimer’s disease and frontotemporal lobar degeneration.
This project tries to find out what causes blunted circadian rhythms in glucocorticoids in patients with breast cancer.
This project develops an imaging method to study how dopamine signaling in the striatum changes during development in a mouse model of autism.
This project tests whether imaging that combines reflectance confocal microscopy and optical coherence tomography can help diagnose oral lesions and cancers.
This project develops fluorescent dyes and turns them into molecular probes for imaging cells and for guiding cancer surgery.
This project studies what causes fat tissue to build up in lymphedema and looks for ways to prevent the condition.
This project tests whether blocking the unfolded protein response in the mold Aspergillus fumigatus could treat fungal keratitis in a mouse model.
This project builds a product with hands-on activities in biomedical sensing, measurement and instrumentation for health science.
This project provides a microscope that studies organs and tumors at the level of individual cells much faster.
This project builds a computer method that uses machine learning and natural language processing to find cancer-related cognitive impairment in clinical notes of older adults.
This project studies the manifestations, mechanisms, prevention and treatment of lung disease and critical illness.
This project develops and supports clinical and translational research that aims to improve health in diverse communities.
This project studies how genomic variation changes the way pancreatic islet beta cells respond to environmental signals that control insulin secretion.
This project develops artificial intelligence algorithms that use clinical data and wearable data to detect and track heart damage from cancer treatments.
This project maps chromatin modifications and RNA Polymerase II across the genome in individual cell types to understand how chromatin varies from cell to cell.
This project looks for microbes that activate enteroendocrine cells and tries to find out how they do it.
